description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component for displaying a list of repositories in the F-Droid app, including onboarding hints, a top app bar, floating action button, and previews.

classes.name: RepositoryInfo
classes.description: Data class containing repository list info, onboarding state, last update, and network status.

methods.name: Repositories
methods.description: Composable function rendering the repositories list UI with onboarding hints, app bar, and floating action button.

methods.name: RepositoriesScaffoldLoadingPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for loading state of repositories list.

methods.name: RepositoriesScaffoldPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for repositories list with data.
